market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Fed rate hike, rising yields, consumer stress, and geopolitical tensions (Hormuz, Greenland) create headwinds. Midterm election anxiety and negative Trump economic poll add political risk. Energy prices elevated. Expect volatility in QQQ and consumer names.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive on energy, AI infrastructure, and India; bearish on consumer discretionary and long-duration growth. Buffett succession creates uncertainty in market leadership. If AI bubble doesn't burst, structural growth continues; if it does, 2042 recovery scenario is plausible.
